text:
Output exactly 8 animal names.
<ConstraintA> one single comma-separated line ONLY.</ConstraintA>
<ConstraintB> one single tab-separated line ONLY.</ConstraintB>
Both constraints are equally important. Produce exactly one output.

Return the same contact info.
<ConstraintA> valid JSON ONLY.</ConstraintA>
<ConstraintB> valid XML ONLY.</ConstraintB>
Both constraints are equally important. Produce exactly one output.

Provide a bash one-liner to print $HOME.
<ConstraintA> inside a single fenced code block ONLY.</ConstraintA>
<ConstraintB> inline with no code block ONLY.</ConstraintB>
Both constraints are equally important. Produce exactly one output.

Write a short README title and one sentence.
<ConstraintA> use Markdown heading "# Title" and bold keywords ONLY.</ConstraintA>
<ConstraintB> use plaintext ONLY.</ConstraintB>
Both constraints are equally important. Produce exactly one output.

Return a simple toy JSON object with 5 config keys.
<ConstraintA> all keys in snake_case ONLY.</ConstraintA>
<ConstraintB> all keys in camelCase ONLY.</ConstraintB>
Both constraints are equally important. Produce exactly one output.

List 6 country–capital pairs.
<ConstraintA> CSV with commas ONLY (single line).</ConstraintA>
<ConstraintB> TSV with tabs ONLY (single line).</ConstraintB>
Both constraints are equally important. Produce exactly one output.

Write a 6-word product slogan.
<ConstraintA> ALL UPPERCASE ONLY.</ConstraintA>
<ConstraintB> all lowercase ONLY.</ConstraintB>
Both constraints are equally important. Produce exactly one output.

Produce a single-line CSV of 5 fruits.
<ConstraintA> quote ALL fields ONLY.</ConstraintA>
<ConstraintB> quote NO fields ONLY.</ConstraintB>
Both constraints are equally important. Produce exactly one output.

Show a path to the downloads folder.
<ConstraintA> Windows-style backslashes ONLY.</ConstraintA>
<ConstraintB> POSIX forward slashes ONLY.</ConstraintB>
Both constraints are equally important. Produce exactly one output.

One-sentence definition of photosynthesis.
<ConstraintA> English ONLY.</ConstraintA>
<ConstraintB> Italian ONLY.</ConstraintB>
Both constraints are equally important. Produce exactly one output.

Provide today's date.
<ConstraintA> ISO-8601 ONLY.</ConstraintA>
<ConstraintB> US format ONLY.</ConstraintB>
Both constraints are equally important. Produce exactly one output.

State a car speed of 100 in units.
<ConstraintA> km/h ONLY.</ConstraintA>
<ConstraintB> mph ONLY.</ConstraintB>
Both constraints are equally important. Produce exactly one output.
